name: invigilator
description: Checks an agent can't pass for itself. Reviewer agents can't write files, a builder can't stop until its QA command passes after its last edit, and a project's own checks run from a skill, a git hook or CI, each counting only once it has failed a planted bad case and passed a good one.

reviewer_agents.title: Reviewer agents
reviewer_agents.description: Agents that may not write files, as name patterns separated by commas, such as *reviewer*, code-reviewer. A project's .claude/invigilator.json can add names but not remove these.

reviewer_shell.title: Reviewer shell commands
reviewer_shell.description: block-writes denies the shell commands that write files. block-all denies every shell command a reviewer runs.

builder_agents.title: Builder agents
builder_agents.description: Agents that must pass the project's QA command after their last edit before they stop, as name patterns separated by commas. Write main for the main session. You accept each project's QA command with /invigilator:setup, which keeps it in your own ~/.claude/invigilator.json.

session_status.title: Status line at session start
session_status.description: once shows what the plugin will block the first time a session starts in a project, and again when that changes. always shows it in every session. off shows only problems.
